text.p: Singapore's City Developments Ltd (CityDev) and Japan's Itochu Corp have bought a commercial building in Osaka's prime commercial district for eight billion yen or about Singapore $91.1 million, said a CityDev statement on Monday.

The purchase of the Umeda Mitsui Building was made from Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd through Pacific Height Enterprises Co, a joint venture formed by CityDev's subsidiary, Union Chain Investment Ltd and Elitist Company Ltd, Itochu's subsidiary.
Union will have a 60 percent stake in the joint venture and Elitist the remaining 40 percent.
The acquisition of the 11-storey building, with a gross floor area of 9,063 square metre, will be completed by June 30.
CityDev said the Japanese property market is believed to have bottomed out and the purchase was in line with the group's regional diversification.
CityDev said the property was currently more than 90 percent occupied and was sold with existing tenancies.
